{{Quote|And then there's the Boiling Sea and Drall, and the Cloudland Peaks on Selonia, and the Gold Beaches on Corellia. You kids have never been swimming in a real, honest ocean, have you'?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to his children|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gold Beaches''' of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] were often referred to as one of the greatest natural wonders of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|There aren't any sea monsters there. They keep all of them on Selonia, because the oceans are much bigger there.|Han Solo, to his children|<ref name="AaC" />}}
Eons of exposure to the breaking waves of the surf and wind manipulated the sand [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] into a soft, almost [[Flour/Legends|flour]]-like powder. The beaches also exhibited a highly reflective quality about them created by the [[Gold/Legends|gold]] [[Mica (mineral)|mica]]-like particles of the shells of a vast number of aquatic arthropod species as well as microscopic organisms, primarily the douradea species of [[Algae/Legends|algae]], mixed in with the [[Pearl/Legends|pearlescent]] particulate of offshore [[Coral/Legends|coral]] reefs. The combination of these particles gave the beaches their namesake as they resembled gold powder. The rarest of the golden beaches were the [[black]] gold beaches of the equatorial regions. The sand had a heavy load of ancient [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Silica/Legends|silica]]. These were considered to be some of the most ancient exposed sands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from a time long before the power of wind and the elements smoothed ancient mountains and volcanoes down to the current soft slopes, mesas and hills of the current geology.

They were located between [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] and [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Republic promised if I ever got caught, they'd extract me and I would retire on the Gold Beaches of Corellia. With full immunity!|Moff Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] managed to get an informant in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in the form of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]]. Tyrak fed the [[Balmorran resistance]] with information under the promise that he would eventually be extracted to lead a peaceful life on the Gold Beaches of Corellia.
